meta_description: Tidy Gardens Manchester offers expert garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Local gardener serving Burnage and surrounding areas. Call 07876 464721 today.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Garden Care — Local Burnage Gardener
hero_subhead: Tidy Gardens transforms overgrown spaces into beautiful outdoor rooms you'll actually use and enjoy.
services_heading: Complete Garden Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From routine maintenance to full landscaping projects, we handle every aspect of garden care so you don't have to.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly lawn care, hedge trimming, and seasonal tidying. We keep your garden looking sharp without you lifting a finger.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim your outdoor space. We clear, tidy, and haul away debris, leaving you with a blank canvas ready for whatever comes next.

services.title: Landscape Design & Build
services.desc: Patios, raised beds, decking, and planting schemes tailored to your taste and budget. Beautiful gardens that work with your home.

services.title: Lawn Care & Treatment
services.desc: Scarifying, aeration, feeding, and weed control to restore tired lawns. Healthier grass, fewer weeds, better drainage.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Pruning
services.desc: Expert shaping and removal of dead wood. We keep trees healthy and safe, and won't leave you with an eyesore.

services.title: Spring & Autumn Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Seasonal refresh to prepare your garden for the months ahead. Leaf clearance, cutting back, and gentle renewal.

about_pullquote: I started this because I hated seeing beautiful gardens neglected by cowboys with no pride.
about_para_1: Tidy Gardens was founded on a simple idea: every garden should make you smile when you look out the window. After 15 years working in landscaping for larger firms, I went independent because I wanted to offer the same quality and attention to detail at prices you wouldn't have to remortgage for. Now we're a tight team covering Burnage, Stockport, and the surrounding areas.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, show up on time, and leave your garden looking genuinely better—not just 'done'. We're not interested in upselling you on work you don't need. Hundreds of Manchester homeowners trust us to look after their outdoor space, and we take that responsibility seriously.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our garden was an absolute jungle when we moved in—couldn't even find the shed. Tidy Gardens cleared it all out, sorted the paths, and now it's actually usable. Really tidy work, fair price, and they even offered to come back monthly to keep it under control. Top job.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a free assessment with the owner and he gave us loads of ideas without trying to push the most expensive option. We went with their landscape package and couldn't be happier. The patio looks brilliant and the planting scheme is exactly what we wanted. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Regular weekly maintenance now and it's the best decision we made. Garden always looks cared for, lad's reliable, and honestly charges less than the other quotes we got. Been using them for two years and won't use anyone else.
reviews.author: David P.
